description: This file contains implementation details for big integer arithmetic used in string parsing, including precomputed powers of 5, methods for reading and converting large integers, and class templates for big unsigned integers.

classes.name: BigUnsigned
classes.description: Template class for arbitrary-precision unsigned integers used in parsing and converting large numbers.

methods.name: ReadFloatMantissa
methods.description: Reads the mantissa of a floating-point number into a big unsigned integer, adjusting for exponent.

methods.name: ReadDigits
methods.description: Parses a string of digits into a big unsigned integer, handling decimal points and zero trimming.

methods.name: FiveToTheNth
methods.description: Computes 5 raised to the power n as a big unsigned integer, using precomputed tables for efficiency.
